items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out with ankle injury.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other Vikings pass-catchers.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled out due to rib injury/strain; full eval tomorrow.
items.why: Rib strain after being carted; painful injury type.
items.implication: Sit rest of day; monitor multi-week risk.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury.
items.implication: Sit; Jets RB committee/backup opportunity spikes.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Jets depth RBs.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs due to knee injury; coach Jeff Hafley says early eval 'does not sound very optimistic' for major concern.
items.why: Knee injury sustained; coach major concern on severity.
items.implication: Sit immediately; handcuff/backup elevation critical ROS if multi-week.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining MIA RBs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looking good; likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout and team decision after hamstring issue; team had not been counting on him.
items.implication: Startable if rostered but monitor snap limits; reverse Bateman/Andrews beneficiaries.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF vs Broncos.
items.implication: Sit; LAR WR target share opens.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for other Rams WRs.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut.
items.implication: Start with confidence as high-upside TE.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell (finger) expected inactive vs Lions; was GTD.
items.implication: Jets WR depth reshuffle; Wilson primary.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/targets for Garrett Wilson and remaining Jets WRs/TEs.

items.text: Jets WRs today in Detroit post-Mitchell inactive: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain; expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 with expanded opportunity.
items.opportunity: Higher target/route share for Wilson and Sadiq.

items.text: Have Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections right now; still possible he plays, late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS. Moore in but limited, Mitchell out.
Sunday AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting on him); Spears GTD hopeful; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman; Q: Parkinson, Bagent.
items.opportunity: Confirm expected players for full roles.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rushing yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep efficiency vs soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps and 5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/g to RBs at 3.2 YPC.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 YPR allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17.
items.why: Brutal matchup + low team total (Daniels out context).

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz 28-30% target share/routes last week; faces IND allowing 4th-most TE yards. Loves him.
